description: This file defines a SwiftUI view struct 'MenuContent' responsible for rendering and managing the content of the menu bar extra in the OpenClaw macOS app. It includes UI elements such as toggles, buttons, pickers, and menus for controlling app settings, health status, connection modes, and debug actions. It also handles microphone device discovery and voice wake configuration.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices using AVCaptureDevice discovery, filters connected devices, and updates the state with the list of microphones.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Saves the browser enabled setting asynchronously into persistent config storage.

methods.name: buildAndSaveBrowserEnabled
methods.description: Builds the config dictionary, updates the 'enabled' key for browser setting, and saves to persistent storage.

methods.name: presentDebugResult
methods.description: Displays an NSAlert with the result of a debug action, showing success or error message.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Switches to a specific app settings tab, opens the settings window, and posts a notification to update UI.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the dashboard URL with current config and opens it in the default browser; shows alert on failure.

methods.name: loadBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the browser control enabled setting from persistent store.
